# jev-planner

> A CLI that writes a coding plan with two or more AI agents and a judge: Codex
> and Claude Code by default draft and cross-review, and Jev picks the finalizer. Published to
> npm as `jev-planner`. Node >= 20.19. MIT. Ships ESM and CommonJS.

This file is an index. It points to the files that document the package and
restates none of their content, so there is nothing here to drift from the
source.

## Packages

Each package ships its `llms.txt` inside its tarball, so after an install it can
be read from `node_modules/<package>/llms.txt` with no network access.

- [jev-planner](packages/jev-planner/llms.txt): the install line, the API, a
  working example, and the mistakes to avoid.

## Docs

The documentation site is https://jev-planner.com. Every page there also exists
as raw markdown — add `.md` to any URL — and https://jev-planner.com/llms.txt
indexes them for an agent.

- [Documentation](https://jev-planner.com/): guides and reference.
- [README](packages/jev-planner/README.md): usage and options. Also in the
  tarball.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jev-planner): the published versions.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and commands for an agent editing this
  repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, the quality gates, commits,
  changesets and releases.
